name: Inherited selection coverage
explanation: Resolves an Item's saved selection through the records contract and lets only eligible selected lines count toward implementation-deck coverage, labeled with their provenance and never as authored evidence.

code.note: Delegates path and containment checks to the records resolver, verifies the selected digest, then reports pin, selected-byte and containing-evidence health separately.
Admits a selection only when its structure resolves, every pin is current and its selected bytes are current at head.
Adds inherited lines as Item-owned assignments labeled with their selection and without an evidence file, so no repair advice can name a nonexistent record.
